description: This file defines Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes for claim-related requests in an insurance management backend. It contains classes for submitting a claim and updating claim status, annotated for Swagger documentation and validation constraints.

classes.name: SubmitClaimRequest
classes.description: DTO for submitting a new claim, including details like policy ID, user ID, claim amount, description, and attachment URL.

classes.name: UpdateClaimStatusRequest
classes.description: DTO for updating the status of an existing claim, including new status, actor user ID, and optional notes.
